claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show exterior only; no view of interior condition, seals, or material certification (food-grade vs chemical-grade) to confirm suitability for all liquids.

risks.risk: Actual number of drums included in the sale is unknown
risks.proof: A clear photo or count confirming exact quantity being sold
risks.if_unproven: price as single unit only, lowest count assumption

risks.risk: Volume/capacity of each drum not stated
risks.proof: Photo showing capacity markings or stamped liter label on drum body
risks.if_unproven: price as smallest common capacity (e.g., unverified small drum)

risks.risk: Interior condition unknown (residue, odor, rust, chemical staining)
Unclear if drums are food-grade or chemical-grade plastic
risks.proof: Close-up of manufacturer stamp/grade marking on drum

risks.risk: Lids, seals, and bungs may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of drum tops showing intact lid/bung/seal

risks.risk: Mixed materials: some drums appear metal, not plastic
risks.proof: Photo clarifying which units are plastic vs metal and whether both are included
risks.if_unproven: price as plastic-only batch, exclude metal drums

risks.risk: Age and prior contents unknown (could affect safety for liquid storage)
risks.proof: Seller statement with photo evidence of origin/previous use label
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown history, worst-case prior chemical use

proof_requests: Confirm exact number of drums included in this listing
Show capacity/volume markings on at least one drum
Show interior of an open drum (residue, rust, cleanliness)
Show close-up of any grade/manufacturer stamp for food-grade verification
Show drum tops to confirm lids, bungs, and seals are present and intact
Clarify whether the metal drums seen in photo 1 are part of this sale
response.reason: Item type (plastic storage drums) is clearly identified by the witness, so it can be priced at worst-case assumptions despite unverified claims about liquid-grade suitability, quantity, and condition.
